summary: Audited recent EuroComply repository state after PR #560 and PR #559 merged. Found a stray tmp-test.txt file introduced by PR #559 and prepared a non-runtime cleanup patch.
findings: No open PRs were present at audit start.
Latest merged PR #559 added tmp-test.txt with test-only content and no production value.
PR #560 changed Supabase live RLS evidence tooling; its head workflows were green, but its merge commit had no workflow runs returned.
Latest main merge commit from PR #559 had no workflow runs returned, so production build/security remains unconfirmed.
Cron configuration remains a single daily Vercel cron pointing at /api/internal/daily-maintenance.
Internal maintenance cron remains token-gated and fails closed when no app base URL is configured in production.
Enterprise demo remains gated by NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_ENTERPRISE_DEMO.

Billing checkout and portal routes remain guarded by authenticated user, organization context, manage_billing permission, trusted mutation checks, rate limiting, step-up, safe return URL resolution, no-store responses, and audit logging.
actions_taken: Removed tmp-test.txt as a safe non-breaking repository hygiene correction.
Recorded this audit action in agent_log.d because the root agent_log.json is large and rewriting it risks truncating historical entries.
next_cycle_focus: Verify PR checks for the cleanup branch after opening the PR.
Merge only after CI/security gates are green.
After merge, verify main merge-commit workflow runs before production release.
